title: Fayetteville, AR — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Fayetteville, AR: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Fayetteville is a city in AR with a population of 95,000. Home of the University of Arkansas with a vibrant arts scene and growing tech sector. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.7.
